system.description:
Fira Mastery Talent created by Wikia user Chellewalker (formally Wikia user Lukewarner).

You treat a Fira as a Simple Weapon (Melee) instead of as an Exotic Weapon (Melee). Additionally, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls with a Fira. This Talent counts as the Weapon Focus (Fira) feat for the purpose of satisfying prerequisites.

If you also have the Weapon Focus (Simple Weapons) feat, the attack bonus provided by this Talent does not stack with the attack bonus provided by Weapon Focus (Simple Weapons).

changes.value: any:unknown:in: Talent Trees, Force Talent Trees, Force Tradition Talent Trees Order of Shasa Talent Tree Edit Edit source History Talk (0) Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide The Order of Shasa is still developing training techniques and abilities, taking most of their influence from Manaan's oceans. You must be a member of The Order of Shasa Force Tradition to select any of the Talents described here. Contents 1 Deception Awareness 2 Greater Weapon Focus (Fira) 3 Progenitor's Call 4 Waveform 5 Homebrew Order of Shasa Talents 5.1 Fira Mastery Deception Awareness[ ] Realizing how devastating the consequences would have been if the Sith had successfully deceived her and her companions during the Jedi Civil War, Shasa has developed a technique for using The Force to detect deceptions. You gain +5 to your Will Defense against uses of the Deception skill. Additionally, you can make a Use the Force check instead of a Perception check to Sense Deception and Sense Influence. You are considered Trained in Perception for the purposes of using this Talent. If you are entitled to a Perception check reroll, you may reroll your Use the Force check instead (subject to the same circumstances and limitations). Greater Weapon Focus (Fira)[ ] Prerequisite: Weapon Focus (Fira) You have mastered the chosen weapon of The Order of Shasa. You gain a +1 bonus on melee attack rolls with a Fira. This bonus stacks with the bonus granted by the Weapon Focus (Fira) feat. Progenitor's Call[ ] You have learned to sense the call of your ancestors and wield it through The Force. Once per encounter, you can telepathically disrupt an opponent by making a Use the Force check against the target's Will Defense. If you succeed, the target is confused by the call, moving -1 Persistent step down the Condition Track and losing its Standard Action on its next turn. A creature can only be affected by this power once per encounter, and the Persistent Condition can be removed with a DC 15 Treat Injury check or by resting for 8 hours. This is a Mind-Affecting effect. Waveform[ ] Taking cues from Manaan's oceans, you know how to emulate wave action using The Force. As a Swift Action, when you use a Telekinetic Force Power (that is, a Force Power with the [Telekinetic] descriptor), you manipulate the particles of the environment around you to add to the force of the impact, allowing you to add your Charisma modifier to any damage dealt (minimum +1). Homebrew Order of Shasa Talents[ ] This Homebrew Content has been Tested per the Untested guidelines. Whether or not it can be used is, as always, the prerogative of the Gamemaster. Additionally, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls with a Fira. This Talent counts as the Weapon Focus (Fira) feat for the purpose of satisfying prerequisites. If you also have the Weapon Focus (Simple Weapons) feat, the attack bonus provided by this Talent does not stack with the attack bonus provided by Weapon Focus (Simple Weapons).
